name: Airbus H125 / AS350 / AS355
summary: The workhorse light single-turbine helicopter of US tour, EMS, police, utility and firefighting operators; the AS355 TwinStar is the twin-engine sibling.

wings: Three-blade main rotor on a compact Starflex hub
engines: Single turbine on the roof behind the mast under a long cowling
Exhaust exits at the rear of the cowling above the tail boom; AS355 shows two exhausts
fuselage: Tall, rounded cabin with a large curved windscreen and big side doors
Skids, often high skid gear or emergency floats
Baggage hatches on the rear fuselage sides
tail: Horizontal stabilizer with small endplate fins
Vertical fin with both an upper part and a ventral fin carrying a tail skid

tellTales: Three-blade main rotor over a tall rounded single-engine cabin
Open two-blade tail rotor on a fin with a ventral skid
Stabilizer with endplate fins near the end of a slim boom

confusedWith.howToTell: The H125 has an open two-blade tail rotor and a narrower cabin; the H130 has a shrouded Fenestron and a wider cabin with a one-piece wraparound windscreen.
The H125 has three blades and a taller, rounder cabin; the 206 has two blades.
The 407 has four blades and a JetRanger-style tail; the H125 has three blades.

usCount.source: FAA registry make/model inquiry (AS350/H125 and AS355 series)
